status: Ready for review; not committed or deployed

tests.database: Disposable SQLite only; production database was read only for permission preflight
tests.initial_failure_and_fix: 13 backdating tests initially failed in setup because the dispensing fixture lacked receiving flags. Corrected the disposable test fixture before invoking the strict resolver; all 13 then passed.

verification.roles_ui: Matches commit 3ed58ef markup except the four prior wrapping/alignment CSS class adjustments

root_causes: Super Admin Gate::before returned true for every ability regardless of checkbox selections.
The legacy edit sales permission implied sales.cancel.
The Sales Cancel link was restricted by role instead of the canonical permission.
InventoryService::cancelSale lacked its own actor permission and sale scope checks; cancellation Livewire model state was unlocked.
SuperAdminSeeder repeatedly synchronized all permissions and reset existing seeded owner data and assignments.
Backdating and credit-sale role bypasses and company settings role bypasses made some revocations ineffective.
remaining_boundaries: Four existing direct user sales.cancel grants remain unchanged; role-only revocation does not remove direct grants or grants from other roles.
Explicit legacy aliases remain documented in roles-permissions-audit.json, except edit sales no longer grants cancellation.
Super Admin company-wide branch visibility and explicit system-owner scope behavior remain; they do not authorize cancellation without sales.cancel.
Historical/generated permissions without literal source checks are listed in the audit. Dynamic permission expressions require manual review.
There is no sales refund endpoint; cancellation preserves payment history and does not issue a cash refund.
Recovery requires trusted container/host console access; no HTTP recovery endpoint exists.

before_rollout: Review this report and the diff before committing or building a release.
Back up each tenant database and preserve its existing environment, APP_KEY, database connection, storage mounts and cache configuration.
Use the existing Docker image rollout process for every tenant application and worker. Set RUN_MIGRATIONS=false for this authorization-only release.
Run the read-only audit using the candidate code and each tenant configuration; review active_super_admin_access_preflight and direct_cancellation_grants before switching traffic.
per_application_container_commands: docker exec -w /var/www/html APP_CONTAINER php artisan permissions:audit
docker exec -w /var/www/html APP_CONTAINER php artisan permission:cache-reset
docker exec -w /var/www/html APP_CONTAINER php artisan config:cache
docker exec -w /var/www/html APP_CONTAINER php artisan route:cache
docker exec -w /var/www/html APP_CONTAINER php artisan view:cache
docker_reviewed_deployment.workers: Roll out the same reviewed image to each tenant worker and restart its long-running processes through the existing supervisor/orchestrator. Do not leave workers running old code.
docker_reviewed_deployment.recovery_only_if_required: docker exec -w /var/www/html APP_CONTAINER php artisan roles:recover-admin COMPANY_ID USER_ID --force
docker_reviewed_deployment.recovery_effect: Grants only direct roles.manage to the explicitly identified active existing Super Admin in that company; logs recovery. It does not assign roles or grant sales.cancel or other business permissions.
docker_reviewed_deployment.post_rollout: For each tenant, verify login, roles, sales.cancel grant/revoke including a fresh login, an authorized receipt, a purchase and report access, and worker health. Do not run production seeders or migrate:fresh.

validation_limits: The 185 distinct automated regression cases use disposable SQLite databases. The configured local MySQL database was used only for read-only permission and active Super Admin access preflight.
The Docker release and individual customer containers have not been deployed or tested in production; run the documented preflight separately for every tenant.
The source inventory detects literal permission checks. Dynamic authorization expressions remain a manual-review boundary.
